items.title: 產業表態挺撥補台電中油 基本薪資連11漲？龔明鑫：提供受調薪衝擊企業「配套」
items.title_en: Industry Voices Support Funding for Taipower and CPC, Basic Wage May Rise for 11 Consecutive Years? Minister Gong Ming‑xin: Provide Packages for Companies Hit by Wage Increases
paras: 經濟部今（15) 日舉行第4場產業公協會交流會議，經濟部長龔明鑫會後表示，當前國內經濟成長亮眼，企業適度調高基層勞工薪資方向正確，產業界普遍認同調升大方向，但調幅需審慎考量。龔明鑫指出，產業界亦全力支持政府合理撥補台電與中油以穩定物價，經濟部更規劃未來8年投入1000億元加碼支持中小微企業轉型發展，若工資調高衝擊弱勢企業，政府責無旁貸將提供必要協助。
針對即將於24日登場的最低工資審議會，龔明鑫受訪時指出，隨著現行月薪29500元、時薪196元劃下句點，若迎來連續11年調漲，外界預期月薪極可能首度挑戰3萬元大關。他表示，今日與會的公協會代表普遍認同最低工資調升的大方向，但科技業以外的中小企業與傳統產業並未完全享受經濟成長紅利，仍面臨獲利有限壓力。
龔明鑫進一步說明，最低工資調高後，勞工退休金提撥、勞保及健保費用均會連動調整，對雇主而言，實際增加的不僅是基本薪資本身，隨之墊高的法定成本負擔同樣沉重。經濟部會在審議會召開時，如實反映產業界對承擔上限的擔憂。至於若中小微企業或傳統產業營運受衝擊，龔明鑫強調，不論最終審定調幅為何，若有弱勢企業面臨困難，政府責無旁貸會予以協助。
此外，在穩定物價與產業支持方面，產業界在會中表達支持政府合理撥補台電、中油，讓兩家國營事業穩健經營，繼續發揮平穩物價、照顧民生的功能。龔明鑫強調，公協會是政府與企業重要的橋樑，經濟部會持續把第一線需求帶進政策。
同時，經濟部持續加大對中小微企業的支持力道，將從每年超過100億元的計畫升級，推動修訂中小微企業轉型升級發展條例，預計未來8年加碼投入1000億元預算。透過數位轉型、淨零轉型、通路發展、群聚共榮、新創拔尖等5大策略，搭配優惠貸款、租稅優惠與信保加碼3大配套，全力協助全台171萬家中小微企業提升國際競爭力。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs held its fourth industry‑association dialogue today (the 15th). After the meeting, Minister Gong Ming‑xin said that the domestic economy is performing well and that it is correct for companies to modestly raise base‑level workers’ wages. The industry broadly agrees with the overall direction of a wage increase, but the magnitude must be considered carefully. Gong noted that the industry fully backs the government’s reasonable subsidies to Taipower and CPC to stabilise prices, and the ministry plans to invest NT$100 billion over the next eight years to further support the transformation of small and micro enterprises. If higher wages hurt vulnerable firms, the government has an undeniable responsibility to provide necessary assistance.

Regarding the minimum‑wage review meeting scheduled for the 24th, Gong said that with the current monthly minimum of NT$29,500 and hourly minimum of NT$196 set to end, a possible 11‑year streak of raises could push the monthly floor to the NT$30,000 mark for the first time. He said that today’s association representatives generally support the overall direction of a higher minimum wage, but small‑ and medium‑sized firms outside the tech sector and traditional industries have not fully enjoyed the benefits of economic growth and still face limited profit pressure.

Gong further explained that once the minimum wage is raised, contributions to workers’ retirement funds, labor insurance and health insurance will also increase, meaning employers will face higher statutory cost burdens in addition to the higher base pay. The ministry will faithfully convey industry concerns about the ceiling of these obligations at the review meeting. Should small‑ and micro‑enterprises or traditional sectors be adversely affected, Gong stressed that regardless of the final adjustment size, the government will step in to help any vulnerable companies that encounter difficulties.

In addition, on price stability and industry support, the business side expressed backing for the government’s reasonable subsidies to Taipower and CPC, enabling the two state‑owned utilities to operate soundly and continue to help keep prices stable and protect livelihoods. Gong emphasized that industry associations serve as an important bridge between the government and businesses, and the ministry will keep bringing frontline needs into policy making.

The ministry also continues to ramp up support for small and micro enterprises, upgrading a program that already exceeds NT$10 billion annually. It will revise the Small and Micro Enterprise Transformation and Upgrading Development Act and plans to inject an additional NT$100 billion over the next eight years. Through five major strategies—digital transformation, net‑zero transition, channel development, cluster prosperity, and nurturing top‑tier startups—combined with three supporting measures—preferential loans, tax incentives and enhanced credit guarantees—the government aims to help Taiwan’s 1.71 million small and micro firms boost their international competitiveness.

items.title: 創博會9/17世貿登場 科技館展技術涵蓋AI應用從晶片散熱到癌症早篩偵測
items.title_en: Taiwan Innovation Expo Opens Sept 17 at Taipei World Trade Center, Showcasing AI from Chip Cooling to Early Cancer Screening
paras: 「2026台灣創新技術博覽會-未來科技館(FUTEX)」將於本周9月17日-19日在台北世貿一館登場，由國科會攜手中研院、教育部、衛福部及運動部主辦。國科會表示，今年未來科技館聚焦AI生活應用、產業關鍵技術及國家科研三大面向，展出從智慧健康、運動賽事與虛擬試衣，到AI晶片散熱、癌症早篩、自主衛星及智慧防災等成果，也完整展現最具體驗性、產業潛力及社會價值的AI科技亮點。
國科會表示，今年未來科技館聚焦三大面向，展出從智慧健康、運動賽事與虛擬試衣，到AI晶片散熱、癌症早篩、自主衛星及智慧防災等成果，完整呈現最具體驗性、產業潛力及社會價值的科技亮點。
國科會指出，AI不再只是研究室裡的模型與數據，而是走入人們的健康、娛樂、消費與飲食生活，今年展場規劃多項互動體驗，讓民眾直接感受AI如何回應生活中的真實需求。
其中包括高雄科大研發的「iMirror人工智慧健康促進暨賦能互動式魔鏡」，透過單一鏡頭與AI邊緣運算，就能分析步態穩定度、體適能及跌倒風險，參觀者只要站在鏡子前走動或伸展，便能看到即時分析結果，未來可應用於醫院復健追蹤及居家照護。
棒球迷則可關注「聽懂球員綽號」的AI賽事系統，由台科大團隊結合語音辨識與多模態AI，自動標記全壘打、三振等事件，民眾只要說出球員名稱或綽號，系統便能快速搜尋並播放相關片段，展現AI應用於賽事轉播、影音內容管理與運動娛樂的新可能。
此外，「生成式AI虛擬試衣系統」讓參觀者站在螢幕前即可體驗AI從服裝設計、樣品製作到智慧零售的應用；「AI豬隻瘦肉量自動化檢測系統」則透過影像辨識，串聯飼養、肉質分級與零售端數據，讓科技深入傳統農畜養殖產業，協助提升生產效率與品質管理。
對企業而言，今年未來科技館遴選出84件獲獎技術，橫跨AI、半導體與光電通訊、生技新藥與醫材、先進材料與化工、綠能環保、淨零及人文科技等領域，其中多項成果已完成初步驗證，或正與產業展開合作。
面對AI高效能運算帶來的散熱與能耗挑戰，「跨重力場被動式螺旋結構液氣分流散熱技術」運用獨創氣泡脫離機制，可整合於高功率AI晶片及資料中心兩相浸沒式冷卻系統；國研院展出的「晶片級先進封裝異質整合平台」，則提供先進製程級別的封裝技術，並獨創去除封裝基板的「CoCoB 」架構，滿足現代資料中心龐大的算力需求。

AI醫療部分，展出診斷平台鎖定早期不易發現的胰臟癌，並已完成跨國臨床盲測驗證；「DeepBT A+腦瘤MRI智慧輔助判讀系統」累積逾2,500例臨床案例，可協助醫療人員進行多任務病灶分析與報告生成，縮短報告周轉時間58%。「PanMETAI—1H NMR代謝體與AI聯合診斷平台」鎖定早期不易發現的胰臟癌，並已完成跨國臨床盲測驗證；「DeepBT A+腦瘤MRI智慧輔助判讀系統」累積逾2,500例臨床案例，可協助醫療人員進行多任務病灶分析與報告生成，縮短報告周轉時間58%。這些成果顯示，AI不只追求模型效能，更能進一步回應臨床流程、產業導入及實際應用需求。
除了產業應用，未來科技館也呈現國家級科研設施與學研團隊如何支援關鍵科技發展，回應環境監測、防災應變、公共安全與國家韌性等需求；國家太空中心以福爾摩沙衛星八號為展出主軸，展示衛星模型、推進次系統、光學遙測酬載及次米級影像應用平臺等成果，讓民眾與產業界了解台灣衛星自主研發的最新進展及太空科技在環境監測、農業、交通與國土管理等領域的應用潛力。
paras_en: The 2026 Taiwan Innovation Technology Expo – Future Technology Hall (FUTEX) will be held from September 17‑19 this week at Hall 1 of the Taipei World Trade Center, organized by the National Science and Technology Council together with Academia Sinica, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Health and Welfare, and the Ministry of Sports. The council says this year’s Future Technology Hall focuses on three pillars – AI life applications, key industrial technologies, and national research – and will exhibit achievements ranging from smart health, sports events and virtual fitting rooms to AI chip cooling, early‑cancer screening, autonomous satellites and intelligent disaster prevention, fully demonstrating AI highlights with the most experiential, industrial potential and social value.

The council states that this year’s Future Technology Hall concentrates on three major aspects, showcasing results from smart health, sports events and virtual fitting rooms to AI chip cooling, early‑cancer screening, autonomous satellites and intelligent disaster prevention, presenting technology highlights that are highly experiential, industrially promising, and socially valuable.

The council points out that AI is no longer confined to models and data in research labs; it has entered people’s health, entertainment, consumption and dietary lives. This year’s exhibition plans multiple interactive experiences so the public can directly feel how AI responds to real‑world needs.

One exhibit is the “iMirror AI Health Promotion and Empowerment Interactive Mirror” developed by Kaohsiung University of Science and Technology. Using a single camera and edge AI computing, it can analyze gait stability, fitness level and fall risk. Visitors who stand, walk or stretch in front of the mirror see real‑time analysis results, a technology that could later be applied to hospital rehabilitation tracking and home care.

Baseball fans can check out an AI sports‑broadcast system that “understands players’ nicknames.” Developed by a team from National Taiwan University of Science and Technology, it combines speech recognition and multimodal AI to automatically tag home runs, strike‑outs and other events. Users simply say a player’s name or nickname, and the system quickly retrieves and plays the relevant clip, showcasing new possibilities for AI in sports broadcasting, video‑content management and entertainment.

A “generative‑AI virtual fitting system” lets visitors stand before a screen and experience AI‑driven applications from garment design and sample production to smart retail. An “AI automated pork leanness detection system” uses image recognition to link breeding, meat‑grade classification and retail data, bringing technology deep into traditional livestock farming to help improve production efficiency and quality control.

For businesses, this year’s Future Technology Hall selected 84 award‑winning technologies spanning AI, semiconductors and optoelectronic communications, biotech drugs and medical devices, advanced materials and chemicals, green energy, net‑zero initiatives, and humanities‑tech. Many of these results have completed preliminary validation or are already collaborating with industry.

Facing the heat‑dissipation and power‑consumption challenges of high‑performance AI computing, a “cross‑gravity‑field passive spiral‑structure liquid‑gas split cooling technology” uses a novel bubble‑release mechanism and can be integrated into high‑power AI chips and two‑phase immersion cooling systems for data centers; Academia Sinica’s “chip‑level advanced packaging heterogeneous integration platform” offers advanced‑process‑level packaging and a unique “CoCoB” architecture that removes the substrate, meeting the massive compute demand of modern data centers.

In AI medical applications, a diagnostic platform targeting early‑stage pancreatic cancer has completed multinational blind clinical trials; the “DeepBT A+ brain‑tumor MRI intelligent assistance system” has accumulated over 2,500 clinical cases, helping clinicians perform multi‑task lesion analysis and report generation, cutting report turnaround time by 58%; the “PanMETAI – 1H NMR metabolomics and AI joint diagnostic platform” also focuses on early pancreatic cancer and has finished cross‑border blind trials. These achievements show that AI not only pursues model performance but also addresses clinical workflow, industry adoption, and real‑world needs.

Beyond industry uses, the Future Technology Hall also showcases national research facilities and academic teams supporting key technology development, responding to environmental monitoring, disaster response, public safety and national resilience needs. The National Space Organization highlights the Formosa Satellite‑8, displaying satellite models, propulsion subsystems, optical remote‑sensing payloads and sub‑meter imaging platforms, helping the public and industry understand Taiwan’s latest autonomous satellite progress and the potential of space technology for environmental monitoring, agriculture, transportation and land‑management.

items.title: 財部拍板中韓電磁鋼品傾銷 追繳反傾銷稅最高達59%
items.title_en: Ministry of Finance Approves Anti-Dumping Duties on Korean and Chinese Electromagnetic Steel, Up to 59%
paras: 財政部今（15）日公告針對自韓國及中國大陸進口「冷軋扁軋非方向性電磁鋼品」反傾銷調查最終認定，確認兩地涉案廠商均存在傾銷事實。其中韓國廠商傾銷差率最高達59.35%，中國廠商則為26.44%。關務署已通知各海關自即日起改依最後認定傾銷差率臨時課徵反傾銷稅，並已移送經濟部進行國家經濟利益與產業損害之最後認定，最快於50天內提報關稅稅率審議小組決定是否正式開徵。
本次反傾銷調查案係由國內鋼鐵龍頭中鋼 (2002-TW) 提出申請。關務署表示，財政部於115年9月15日正式公告調查結果，證實自韓國及中國進口之冷軋扁軋非方向性電磁鋼品確實對國內產業造成不公競爭。

關務署說明，財政部先前於115年6月2日公告初步認定結果，並自6月8日起實施臨時課徵反傾銷稅。由於本次最後認定之傾銷差率有所調整，關務署已同步通知各進口地海關，自9月15日起改依最後認定之最新傾銷差率進行臨時課徵。若最終審議核定無須課徵反傾銷稅，先前臨時課徵之款項將依法辦理退還。
針對後續調查流程，關務署進一步指出，財政部已依據「平衡稅及反傾銷稅課徵實施辦法」規定，通知經濟部繼續完成傾銷是否對台灣產業造成損害之最後調查認定，並評估課稅對國家整體經濟利益之影響。經濟部將於接獲通知翌日起40日內完成調查認定；財政部則會在收到經濟部通知後10日內，提交關稅稅率審議小組審議，以做出最終是否正式課徵反傾銷稅之決議。
paras_en: The Ministry of Finance announced today (the 15th) the final anti‑dumping investigation results for imports of "cold‑rolled flat‑rolled non‑grain-oriented electromagnetic steel" from South Korea and mainland China, confirming that manufacturers in both regions have engaged in dumping. The Korean firms’ dumping margin tops out at 59.35%, while the Chinese firms’ margin is 26.44%. The Customs Administration has instructed all customs offices to start levying provisional anti‑dumping duties based on the final margin rates from today, and the case has been forwarded to the Ministry of Economic Affairs for a final determination of national economic interest and industry damage, with a proposal to the Tariff Rate Review Committee expected within 50 days.

The anti‑dumping case was initiated by domestic steel leader China Steel (2002‑TW). The Customs Administration said the Ministry of Finance formally announced the investigation results on September 15, 2026, confirming that imports of cold‑rolled flat‑rolled non‑grain‑oriented electromagnetic steel from Korea and China create unfair competition for the local industry.

Because the final dumping margins have been adjusted, customs offices have been notified to apply the updated provisional duties starting September 15. If the final review decides no duties are required, the previously collected provisional duties will be refunded according to law.

Regarding the next steps, the Customs Administration said the Ministry of Finance, pursuant to the "Implementation Measures for Balanced Tax and Anti‑Dumping Tax," has instructed the Ministry of Economic Affairs to complete the final assessment of whether dumping harms Taiwan’s industry and to evaluate the impact of the duties on overall national economic interests. The Ministry of Economic Affairs will finish its investigation within 40 days of receiving the notice, and the Ministry of Finance will submit the findings to the Tariff Rate Review Committee within 10 days thereafter to decide whether to impose formal anti‑dumping duties.

items.title: 華爾街劃出美股生死線！10年期美債殖利率攻入危險區
items.title_en: Wall Street Draws a Survival Line for US Stocks! 10-Year Treasury Yield Enters Dangerous Zone
paras: 美國10年期公債殖利率近3年來首度突破5%，正值美股進入歷來波動較劇烈的時期，進一步升高市場修正壓力。策略師認為，殖利率突破5%本身未必足以終結多頭，真正關鍵在於接下來上升的速度，以及聯準會(Fed)周三升息後，是否暗示還有更多緊縮行動。

殖利率升破5% 科技股估值首當其衝

與2023年10月美債殖利率突破5%時不同，當時標普500指數較歷史高點低約10%，目前卻僅較8月創下的紀錄低約2.5%，市場也開始懷疑，美股是否尚未充分反映債市風險。
富國銀行(WFC-US)等機構策略師指出，殖利率對美股的實際衝擊，將取決於後續上升速度。若殖利率短時間內急漲，勢必加劇華爾街焦慮；如果只是緩步攀升，市場可能仍有時間消化。
公債殖利率走高會降低企業未來獲利的現值，並使股票相較低風險債券失去吸引力，同時推升企業融資成本、侵蝕利潤率。其中，高成長、高本益比科技股尤其脆弱，因為這類公司的估值高度仰賴多年後才能實現的獲利。

多名策略師已為美股劃出警戒線。Wealth Enhancement投資組合經理Max Wasserman認為，美國10年期公債殖利率介於5%至5.25%，將是標普500的心理臨界區；Jackson Square Capital合夥人Andrew Graham則警告，一旦升破5.1%，可能觸發美股修正。22V Research策略師Dennis Debusschere表示，即使殖利率維持在4.8%至5%，也會對經濟成長形成一定壓力。
美股目前仍展現韌性。標普500自3月底低點反彈20%，期間市值增加11兆美元；即使周一債市遭到拋售，華爾街恐慌指數(VIX)仍維持在17附近，尚未顯示市場陷入明顯壓力。不過，Wolfe Research首席經濟學家Stephanie Roth警告，若利率或油價進一步攀升，美股出現更大幅度修正的機率也會提高。

Fed若未釋出「升一次就停」訊號 美股恐承受更大壓力

利率期貨顯示，交易員預估Fed周三升息1碼的機率接近90%。市場焦點將轉向Fed主席華許會後記者會，尋找今年底前是否還會繼續升息的線索。
富國銀行首席股票策略師Ohsung Kwon表示，投資人最樂見Fed傳達「升一次就停」的訊息；若Fed意外按兵不動，反而可能被市場視為利空，因為此舉可能讓投資人懷疑Fed抗通膨的決心，進而推升長天期美債殖利率。
Wasserman也表示，如果Fed暗示升息一次後就踩煞車，交易員可望鬆一口氣；但若華許未說明未來升息次數，或暗示壓低通膨需要更長時間，殖利率維持在5%以上，將迫使投資人重新評估昂貴估值，長天期科技股恐率先下跌。
目前標普500獲利收益率與10年期美債殖利率之間的股權風險溢酬，已接近2002年以來最低，代表投資人持有股票所獲得的額外補償有限。摩根大通(JPM-US)策略師Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou團隊預估，該溢酬可能比歷史平均低100個基點，使美股對殖利率波動更加敏感。
不過，Raymond James(RJF-US)投資長Larry Adam認為，債券投資人情緒已極度悲觀，10年期美債投機性空頭部位也接近歷史高點，這波賣壓可能已經過度延伸，意味殖利率或許更接近高峰，而非新一輪持續上漲的起點。
paras_en: US 10-year Treasury yields have broken above 5% for the first time in three years, coinciding with a historically volatile period for US equities and increasing market correction pressure. Strategists say that the yield crossing 5% alone may not end the bull market; the key is the speed of further rises and whether Wednesday’s Fed rate hike signals more tightening.

The impact on tech stock valuations is immediate. Unlike October 2023, when the 5% yield breach occurred while the S&P 500 was about 10% below its all‑time high, the index is now only about 2.5% below its August record, leading the market to wonder if equities have fully priced in bond‑market risk.

Wells Fargo (WFC‑US) and other institutional strategists note that the actual effect of yields on US stocks will depend on the pace of further increases. A rapid spike would heighten Wall Street anxiety, whereas a gradual climb could give the market time to digest.

Higher Treasury yields lower the present value of future corporate earnings and make stocks less attractive relative to low‑risk bonds, while also raising corporate financing costs and squeezing profit margins. High‑growth, high‑P/E tech stocks are especially vulnerable because their valuations rely heavily on profits many years out.

Several strategists have drawn warning lines for equities. Wealth Enhancement portfolio manager Max Wasserman sees a 5%‑5.25% 10‑year yield as a psychological threshold for the S&P 500; Jackson Square Capital partner Andrew Graham warns that a breach of 5.1% could trigger a correction; 22V Research’s Dennis Debusschere says even a 4.8%‑5% range would put pressure on economic growth.

US equities still show resilience. The S&P 500 has rebounded about 20% from its late‑March low, adding $11 trillion in market cap; even after Monday’s bond‑sell‑off, the VIX stayed near 17, showing no clear sign of stress. However, Wolfe Research chief economist Stephanie Roth cautions that further rate or oil price hikes could raise the odds of a larger equity correction.

If the Fed does not signal a “one‑and‑done” hike, US stocks could face greater pressure. Rate‑futures indicate a near‑90% chance the Fed will raise rates by 0.25% on Wednesday, shifting focus to Chair Jerome Powell’s post‑meeting press conference for clues on whether more hikes are coming before year‑end.

Wells Fargo chief equity strategist Ohsung Kwon says investors would welcome a “one‑and‑done” message from the Fed; an unexpected pause could be viewed as negative, suggesting doubts about the Fed’s resolve on inflation and potentially pushing long‑term yields higher.

Wasserman adds that if the Fed signals a pause after one hike, traders could breathe easier; but if Powell leaves future hikes ambiguous or hints that taming inflation will take longer, yields staying above 5% would force investors to reassess pricey valuations, with long‑term tech stocks likely to fall first.

The equity risk premium—the spread between the S&P 500 earnings yield and the 10‑year Treasury yield—is now near its lowest since 2002, indicating limited extra compensation for holding stocks. JPMorgan (JPM‑US) strategist Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou’s team estimates the premium could be about 100 basis points below its historical average, making equities more sensitive to yield moves.

Nevertheless, Raymond James (RJF‑US) chief investment officer Larry Adam argues bond‑market sentiment is extremely bearish, with speculative short positions on the 10‑year Treasury near historic highs. This selling pressure may be overextended, suggesting yields could be near their peak rather than the start of a new sustained rise.

items.title: 升級後故障照樣收錢？蘋果「軟體不保固」條款遭印度調查
items.title_en: Upgraded Yet Still Charged? Apple’s “Software Not Covered by Warranty” Clause Under Investigation in India
paras: 印度消費者監管機關正升級調查蘋果(AAPL-US)的軟體保固條款，起因是部分消費者指控，升級iOS 18後出現螢幕及麥克風故障，卻因蘋果不為軟體提供保固，被迫支付「高得離譜」的維修費用。若違法事實成立，蘋果除可能遭到罰款，也可能被要求退款或修改現行保固與營運做法。

印度下令深入調查 蘋果否認iOS 18存在系統性問題

《路透》取得的文件顯示，印度中央消費者保護局(CCPA)去年收到大量申訴，指蘋果2024年底推出iOS 18後，部分iPhone出現螢幕顯示異常、麥克風故障等問題，但因軟體不在保固範圍內，消費者必須自行負擔維修費。
CCPA今年7月29日通知蘋果，已將案件交由調查部門進行「深入調查」，並指案件涉及涉嫌侵害消費者權益。此舉顯示印度政府並不滿意蘋果先前提出的說明，也提高公司遭到處分的風險。
蘋果在8月提交的回函中反駁指控，強調iOS 18經過嚴格測試，在印度並未發現系統性問題或安全疑慮，且調查僅源自75件申訴。截至2026年6月，仍使用iOS 18的iPhone占比也只有約11%。蘋果表示，將繼續與印度主管機關合作，釐清消費者反映的問題。
印度消費者法允許調查人員要求企業提交文件並舉行聽證，之後再向監管機關提出最終報告。專精消費者法的律師Kirti Mahapatra表示，若契約或保固條款被認定構成不公平交易行為，CCPA可要求企業向消費者提供正確資訊，甚至修改相關條款，但後者在印度將是前所未見的作法。

軟體故障不在保固範圍 維修費超過手機售價三分之一

蘋果的軟體授權協議載明，軟體「不附帶任何形式的保固」，若軟體發生瑕疵，相關維修成本須由使用者自行承擔，全球有限保固僅涵蓋硬體。
蘋果主張，軟體不提供保固符合全球產業慣例，消費者也會在安裝前得知相關條款，其內容與索尼(SONY-US)、三星電子等電子產品大廠相近。公司並稱，如果每項軟體問題都被視為違反絕對保固，等同要求所有軟體供應商為一切科技風險承擔保險責任。
不過，CCPA指控，部分iPhone在升級iOS 18後，螢幕出現綠色、粉紅色或白色線條，消費者即使認為故障源自軟體更新，仍須支付高額費用更換螢幕。以iPhone 15為例，螢幕維修估計需27,900盧比(約291美元)，超過手機零售價的三分之一。
CCPA認為，若問題源自蘋果本身的疏失，卻仍向消費者收取維修費，恐違反公平交易原則。義大利早在2018年也曾處分蘋果，原因是公司未充分告知消費者，iOS 10可能影響舊款iPhone效能，且未向保固期外的裝置提供適當支援。
這項調查也為蘋果在印度的擴張增添變數。印度是蘋果重要成長市場，公司正快速擴大當地iPhone製造規模，市占率也從2022年的4%升至2025年的9%，但同時還須應對涉嫌違反印度反壟斷法的指控。
paras_en: India's consumer regulator is escalating its probe into Apple (AAPL-US) software warranty terms after some consumers claimed that after upgrading to iOS 18 they experienced screen and microphone failures, but because Apple does not provide a warranty for software they were forced to pay "exorbitant" repair costs. If the alleged violations are confirmed, Apple could face fines, be ordered to refund customers, or have to change its warranty and operational practices.

India ordered a deep dive into the matter, with Apple denying any systemic issues in iOS 18. Reuters obtained documents showing that the Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) received a flood of complaints last year alleging that after Apple rolled out iOS 18 at the end of 2024, some iPhones showed screen anomalies and microphone failures, yet because the software is not covered by warranty, consumers had to bear repair expenses themselves.

The CCPA notified Apple on July 29 that it had referred the case to its investigation unit for a "thorough inquiry," indicating the matter involves alleged infringement of consumer rights. This move shows the Indian government is unsatisfied with Apple's earlier explanations and raises the risk of punitive action against the company.

In a response filed in August, Apple rebutted the accusations, stressing that iOS 18 underwent rigorous testing, that no systemic or safety issues have been found in India, and that the investigation stems from only 75 complaints. As of June 2026, only about 11% of iPhones still run iOS 18. Apple said it will continue cooperating with Indian authorities to clarify the consumer‑raised issues.

India’s consumer law allows investigators to demand documents from companies and hold hearings before submitting a final report to the regulator. Consumer‑law specialist Kirti Mahapatra said that if a contract or warranty clause is deemed an unfair trade practice, the CCPA can compel the company to provide correct information to consumers and even amend the clause – a step unprecedented in India.

Apple’s software license agreement states that the software "comes with no warranty of any kind," and if a software defect occurs, the user must bear any repair costs; the limited global warranty covers only hardware.

Apple argues that offering no warranty on software aligns with global industry practice and that consumers are informed of the terms before installation, noting that the language is similar to that used by Sony (SONY-US), Samsung Electronics and other major electronics makers. The company adds that treating every software issue as a breach of an absolute warranty would effectively require all software vendors to carry insurance for every technological risk.

However, the CCPA alleges that some iPhones, after upgrading to iOS 18, displayed green, pink or white lines on the screen, and even if consumers attribute the fault to the software update they still have to pay high fees to replace the screen. For an iPhone 15, screen repair is estimated at 27,900 rupees (about $291), more than one‑third of the phone’s retail price.

The CCPA contends that if the problem stems from Apple’s own negligence yet the company still charges consumers for repairs, it may violate fair‑trade principles. Italy similarly penalised Apple in 2018 for failing to adequately inform consumers that iOS 10 could affect performance on older iPhone models and for not providing proper support to devices out of warranty.

The investigation adds uncertainty to Apple’s expansion plans in India. India is a key growth market for Apple, which is rapidly scaling local iPhone manufacturing and has lifted its market share from 4% in 2022 to 9% in 2025, but it also faces allegations of breaching Indian antitrust laws.

items.title: 能率亞洲現增案完成募集4.61億元 現增股9/18上櫃買賣
items.title_en: Nengli Asia Completes Capital Raise of NT$461 million; New Shares to Trade on OTC on Sep 18
paras: 創投業指標股能率亞洲 (7777-TW)執行上櫃以來首度的市場籌資案，能率亞洲發行1.6萬張現增股，以每股28.8元發行，今(15)日宣布完成募 籌資約4.61億元，現增股9月18日上櫃交易。
能率亞洲的此一發行1.6萬張現增股的市場籌資案，由第一金證券主辦，由全體股東依持股比例認購。募集資金用途將爲充實營運資金。
能率亞洲今天股價收在35.35元，相較於現增價有仍有22.74%的價差空間，且能率亞洲並已取得 OTC 的融資、融券交易資格。
目前能率亞洲著眼投資四大領域，包含 AI 供應鏈、機器人、半導體、軍工，著眼在產業發展趨勢。同時亦布局高殖利率股，兼顧獲利穩定。
同時，全球首家成功商業化機器人廠商 Agility，是能率亞洲在機器人概念的重點持股。能率亞洲及能率集團相關資金合計投資約 1000 萬美元，Agility Robotics 已與主要客戶完成完整測試，結果符合預期，並與豐田汽車就加拿大工廠物流自動化啟動概念驗證。
能率亞洲2026年上半年財報稅後純益1.51億元，每股純益0.81元。
paras_en: Venture-capital benchmark stock Nengli Asia (7777‑TW) executed its first market capital‑raising since listing on the OTC, issuing 16,000 new shares at NT$28.8 each. The company announced today (the 15th) that it has completed fundraising of about NT$461 million, and the new shares will begin OTC trading on September 18.
The 16,000‑share issuance was organized by First Financial Securities, with all shareholders subscribing in proportion to their holdings. The proceeds will be used to strengthen working capital.
Nengli Asia’s stock closed today at NT$35.35, leaving a 22.74% price gap above the issuance price, and the company has already obtained OTC financing and margin‑trading qualifications.

The company is focusing its investments on four major areas—AI supply chain, robotics, semiconductors and defense industry—aligned with industry trends, while also allocating to high‑yield stocks for stable earnings.

Agility Robotics, the world’s first company to successfully commercialize robots, is a key robotics‑concept holding for Nengli Asia. Together with the Nengli Group, they have invested roughly US$10 million; Agility Robotics has completed full testing with major customers, meeting expectations, and has launched a proof‑of‑concept with Toyota for logistics automation at a Canadian plant.
Nengli Asia reported a post‑tax net profit of NT$151 million for the first half of 2026, equating to earnings of NT$0.81 per share.

items.title: 為何Google、Meta逆勢上漲？AI巨頭喊放慢開發科技股承壓
items.title_en: Why Google and Meta Rise Against the Trend? AI Giants Call for Slowing Development, Tech Stocks Under Pressure
paras: 在 Anthropic、OpenAI 與SpaceX(SPCX-US) 高層相繼呼籲放慢人工智慧（AI）開發之際，科技股週一（14日）普遍承壓，但Google(GOOGL-US) 母公司 Alphabet 與 Facebook 母公司Meta(META-US) 反而受到投資人青睞，股價逆勢走高。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，Alphabet 股價週一收盤上漲3.22%，Meta 也上漲2.71%；與此同時，科技股占比較高的那斯達克100指數則下跌0.82%，市場持續消化 AI 開發速度可能放緩的影響。
分析指出，Alphabet 與 Meta 都正在打造各自的 AI 系統，因此若 Claude、ChatGPT 與 Grok 背後的開發商協調放慢 AI 發展腳步，兩家公司可能成為受惠者。
Google 本月稍早推出最新版本 Gemini 聊天機器人 Gemini 3.8 Flash；Meta 面向消費者的 AI 代理 Muse 則在上週躍居 App Store 排名前三名。
不過，根據 OpenLM 大型語言模型排行榜，Gemini 與 Muse 的最新版本目前排名仍落後於 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5.1、OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Astra，以及 SpaceX 的 Grok-4.6。
因此，若目前領先的三大 AI 公司放慢開發速度，Alphabet 與 Meta 與競爭對手之間的差距可能縮小，AI 市場的競爭格局也可能因此改變。
New Street Research 分析師 Dan Salmon 表示，市場對 AI 風險的疑慮，也可能讓 Alphabet 與 Meta 有更多空間調整自身定位。
其中，Meta 的布局重點放在資料中心租賃，Google 則更加著重自身的分銷與晶片業務。
今年以來，隨著投資人資金大量湧向晶片與記憶體類股，Alphabet 與 Meta 股價表現始終缺乏明確方向。
截至上週五（11日）收盤，Alphabet 年初至今上漲8.2%，Meta 則下跌1.8%。
paras_en: As senior executives at Anthropic, OpenAI and SpaceX (SPCX-US) call for a slowdown in artificial intelligence (AI) development, technology stocks were generally under pressure on Monday (the 14th), but Alphabet, Google’s parent company, and Meta, the parent of Facebook, were instead favored by investors and saw their shares climb against the tide.

According to the Barron’s Weekly report, Alphabet closed up 3.22% on Monday and Meta rose 2.71%; at the same time, the Nasdaq‑100, which has a high weighting of tech stocks, fell 0.82% as the market continued to digest the potential impact of a slower AI development pace.

Analysts note that both Alphabet and Meta are building their own AI systems, so if the developers behind Claude, ChatGPT and Grok coordinate a slowdown in AI progress, the two companies could be beneficiaries.
Google earlier this month launched the latest version of its Gemini chatbot, Gemini 3.8 Flash; Meta’s consumer‑facing AI agent Muse jumped into the top three on the App Store last week.
However, according to the OpenLM large language model ranking, the newest versions of Gemini and Muse still trail Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5.1, OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra and SpaceX’s Grok‑4.6.

Therefore, if the three leading AI firms currently slow their development, the gap between Alphabet and Meta and their rivals could narrow, potentially reshaping the competitive landscape of the AI market.
New Street Research analyst Dan Salmon said that market concerns about AI risks could also give Alphabet and Meta more room to adjust their positioning.
Meta’s strategy focuses on data‑center leasing, while Google places greater emphasis on its distribution and chip businesses.
Since the start of the year, as investors have poured large amounts of capital into chip and memory stocks, Alphabet’s and Meta’s share performance has lacked a clear direction.
As of last Friday’s (the 11th) close, Alphabet is up 8.2% year‑to‑date, while Meta is down 1.8%.

items.title: 建構全台環島車充電路網 交通部：截至目前公共充電樁已逾1.6萬槍
items.title_en: Building a Nationwide Island‑wide EV Charging Network: MOEA Reports Over 16,000 Public Chargers
paras: 為建構電動車友善使用環境，滿足日益成長的電動車充電需求，交通部推動公共充電樁建置，截至今(2026)年7月底，全國公共充電樁總數已達16,280槍，對應同期電動小客車登記數共149,322輛，車樁比為9.2:1，優於歐盟建議之10:1，其中快充的車樁比為35.7:1，也優於歐盟建議之80:1。
交通部路政司指出，為布局環臺充電路網，解決電動車駕駛在公路沿線上之長途里程焦慮，相關部屬機關已於各所屬轄管場域設有充電站點，提供民眾中繼補電之服務。
交通部舉例，在國道上，高公局已於2024年8月完成「國道服務區充電路網全面上線」，且全數為200kW以上快充樁，七成為350、360kW，配合電動車數量成長，高公路在今年度更針對清水服務區及湖口服務區(南北站)，已啟動優先擴充充電車位作業，三站各增設4格，共計擴充12格，持續提升電動車充電服務；清水服務區已於今年2月擴充完成並開始營運，目前國道快充站共計設有154格充電車位。
另外，在西部主要幹線台61線西濱快速公路沿線，公路局已分別於新豐休息站、大安休息站及口湖休息站共計設有13槍快充樁；東部地區則有台鐵公司亦於去(2025)年7月完成啟用「宜花東充電站網絡」，沿著台9線公路及緊臨台鐵車站， 於宜蘭縣、花蓮縣及臺東縣9個站點，共計設置20槍公共充電樁，緩解民眾在東部駕駛電動車之里程焦慮。
路政司官員表示，隨著公部門帶頭布建，國內的電動車充電環境已逐步完善，並帶動民間充電樁市場發展日趨蓬勃，據資料蒐集顯示，目前已有54家充電營運商投入充電服務，相較2023年第3季總家數成長更達一倍以上。
未來交通部除持續攜手相關部會與地方政府推動增設公共充電樁外，政策推動亦將由初期「積極擴增數量」階段，深化至「提升營運服務品質」階段，如確保充電設施可用性、也督促業者落實營運管理等，藉此打造更便捷、可靠且友善的公共充電服務網絡。
paras_en: To create an EV‑friendly environment and meet the growing demand for electric‑vehicle charging, the Ministry of Transportation and Communications (MOTC) has been promoting the installation of public charging stations. As of the end of July 2026, the total number of public chargers nationwide reached 16,280 units, corresponding to 149,322 registered electric passenger cars, yielding a vehicle‑to‑charger ratio of 9.2:1—better than the EU’s recommended 10:1. For fast chargers, the ratio is 35.7:1, also surpassing the EU’s 80:1 guideline.

The MOTC’s Road Administration Department noted that, to establish an island‑wide charging network and alleviate long‑distance range anxiety for EV drivers on highways, relevant agencies have set up charging stations within their respective jurisdictions to provide intermediate recharging services for the public.

The ministry cited that on national highways, the Highways Bureau completed the “Comprehensive Launch of Highway Service Area Charging Network” in August 2024, installing only fast chargers of 200 kW or higher, with 70 % rated at 350‑360 kW. In response to rising EV numbers, the bureau has prioritized expanding charging spots at Qingshui and Hukou service areas (north‑south stations) this year, adding four spots at each of the three stations for a total of 12 new spots. Qingshui’s expansion was completed and began operation in February 2024, bringing the total number of fast‑charging spots on national highways to 154.

Along the western main corridor, the Taiwan Provincial Highway 61 West Coast Expressway, the Highway Bureau has installed 13 fast‑charging units at Xin‑Feng, Da‑An, and Kou‑Lu rest areas. In the east, Taiwan Railways Administration launched the “Yihua‑Dong Charging Station Network” in July 2025, placing 20 public chargers across nine stations in Yilan, Hualien and Taitung along Highway 9 and adjacent railway stations, easing range anxiety for eastern EV drivers.

A Road Administration official said that as the public sector leads the rollout, the domestic EV charging environment is gradually improving, spurring robust growth in the private‑sector charging market. Data shows that 54 charging operators are now providing services, more than double the number recorded in Q3 2023.

Going forward, the MOTC will continue collaborating with other ministries and local governments to add more public chargers. Policy focus will shift from the initial “aggressive quantity expansion” phase to a “enhancing service quality” phase, ensuring charger availability and urging operators to implement proper management, thereby building a more convenient, reliable, and user‑friendly public charging network.

items.title: 產業表態挺撥補台電中油 基本薪資連11漲？龔明鑫：提供受調薪衝擊企業「配套」
items.title_en: Industry Voices Support Funding for Taipower and CPC, Basic Wage May Rise for 11 Consecutive Years? Minister Gong Ming‑xin: Provide Packages for Companies Hit by Wage Increases
paras: 經濟部今（15) 日舉行第4場產業公協會交流會議，經濟部長龔明鑫會後表示，當前國內經濟成長亮眼，企業適度調高基層勞工薪資方向正確，產業界普遍認同調升大方向，但調幅需審慎考量。龔明鑫指出，產業界亦全力支持政府合理撥補台電與中油以穩定物價，經濟部更規劃未來8年投入1000億元加碼支持中小微企業轉型發展，若工資調高衝擊弱勢企業，政府責無旁貸將提供必要協助。
針對即將於24日登場的最低工資審議會，龔明鑫受訪時指出，隨著現行月薪29500元、時薪196元劃下句點，若迎來連續11年調漲，外界預期月薪極可能首度挑戰3萬元大關。他表示，今日與會的公協會代表普遍認同最低工資調升的大方向，但科技業以外的中小企業與傳統產業並未完全享受經濟成長紅利，仍面臨獲利有限壓力。
龔明鑫進一步說明，最低工資調高後，勞工退休金提撥、勞保及健保費用均會連動調整，對雇主而言，實際增加的不僅是基本薪資本身，隨之墊高的法定成本負擔同樣沉重。經濟部會在審議會召開時，如實反映產業界對承擔上限的擔憂。至於若中小微企業或傳統產業營運受衝擊，龔明鑫強調，不論最終審定調幅為何，若有弱勢企業面臨困難，政府責無旁貸會予以協助。
此外，在穩定物價與產業支持方面，產業界在會中表達支持政府合理撥補台電、中油，讓兩家國營事業穩健經營，繼續發揮平穩物價、照顧民生的功能。龔明鑫強調，公協會是政府與企業重要的橋樑，經濟部會持續把第一線需求帶進政策。
同時，經濟部持續加大對中小微企業的支持力道，將從每年超過100億元的計畫升級，推動修訂中小微企業轉型升級發展條例，預計未來8年加碼投入1000億元預算。透過數位轉型、淨零轉型、通路發展、群聚共榮、新創拔尖等5大策略，搭配優惠貸款、租稅優惠與信保加碼3大配套，全力協助全台171萬家中小微企業提升國際競爭力。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs held its fourth industry‑association dialogue today (the 15th). After the meeting, Minister Gong Ming‑xin said that the domestic economy is performing well and that it is correct for companies to modestly raise base‑level workers’ wages. The industry broadly agrees with the overall direction of a wage increase, but the magnitude must be considered carefully. Gong noted that the industry fully backs the government’s reasonable subsidies to Taipower and CPC to stabilise prices, and the ministry plans to invest NT$100 billion over the next eight years to further support the transformation of small and micro enterprises. If higher wages hurt vulnerable firms, the government has an undeniable responsibility to provide necessary assistance.

Regarding the minimum‑wage review meeting scheduled for the 24th, Gong said that with the current monthly minimum of NT$29,500 and hourly minimum of NT$196 set to end, a possible 11‑year streak of raises could push the monthly floor to the NT$30,000 mark for the first time. He said that today’s association representatives generally support the overall direction of a higher minimum wage, but small‑ and medium‑sized firms outside the tech sector and traditional industries have not fully enjoyed the benefits of economic growth and still face limited profit pressure.

Gong further explained that once the minimum wage is raised, contributions to workers’ retirement funds, labor insurance and health insurance will also increase, meaning employers will face higher statutory cost burdens in addition to the higher base pay. The ministry will faithfully convey industry concerns about the ceiling of these obligations at the review meeting. Should small‑ and micro‑enterprises or traditional sectors be adversely affected, Gong stressed that regardless of the final adjustment size, the government will step in to help any vulnerable companies that encounter difficulties.

In addition, on price stability and industry support, the business side expressed backing for the government’s reasonable subsidies to Taipower and CPC, enabling the two state‑owned utilities to operate soundly and continue to help keep prices stable and protect livelihoods. Gong emphasized that industry associations serve as an important bridge between the government and businesses, and the ministry will keep bringing frontline needs into policy making.

The ministry also continues to ramp up support for small and micro enterprises, upgrading a program that already exceeds NT$10 billion annually. It will revise the Small and Micro Enterprise Transformation and Upgrading Development Act and plans to inject an additional NT$100 billion over the next eight years. Through five major strategies—digital transformation, net‑zero transition, channel development, cluster prosperity, and nurturing top‑tier startups—combined with three supporting measures—preferential loans, tax incentives and enhanced credit guarantees—the government aims to help Taiwan’s 1.71 million small and micro firms boost their international competitiveness.

items.title: 創博會9/17世貿登場 科技館展技術涵蓋AI應用從晶片散熱到癌症早篩偵測
items.title_en: Taiwan Innovation Expo Opens Sept 17 at Taipei World Trade Center, Showcasing AI from Chip Cooling to Early Cancer Screening
paras: 「2026台灣創新技術博覽會-未來科技館(FUTEX)」將於本周9月17日-19日在台北世貿一館登場，由國科會攜手中研院、教育部、衛福部及運動部主辦。國科會表示，今年未來科技館聚焦AI生活應用、產業關鍵技術及國家科研三大面向，展出從智慧健康、運動賽事與虛擬試衣，到AI晶片散熱、癌症早篩、自主衛星及智慧防災等成果，也完整展現最具體驗性、產業潛力及社會價值的AI科技亮點。
國科會表示，今年未來科技館聚焦三大面向，展出從智慧健康、運動賽事與虛擬試衣，到AI晶片散熱、癌症早篩、自主衛星及智慧防災等成果，完整呈現最具體驗性、產業潛力及社會價值的科技亮點。
國科會指出，AI不再只是研究室裡的模型與數據，而是走入人們的健康、娛樂、消費與飲食生活，今年展場規劃多項互動體驗，讓民眾直接感受AI如何回應生活中的真實需求。
其中包括高雄科大研發的「iMirror人工智慧健康促進暨賦能互動式魔鏡」，透過單一鏡頭與AI邊緣運算，就能分析步態穩定度、體適能及跌倒風險，參觀者只要站在鏡子前走動或伸展，便能看到即時分析結果，未來可應用於醫院復健追蹤及居家照護。
棒球迷則可關注「聽懂球員綽號」的AI賽事系統，由台科大團隊結合語音辨識與多模態AI，自動標記全壘打、三振等事件，民眾只要說出球員名稱或綽號，系統便能快速搜尋並播放相關片段，展現AI應用於賽事轉播、影音內容管理與運動娛樂的新可能。
此外，「生成式AI虛擬試衣系統」讓參觀者站在螢幕前即可體驗AI從服裝設計、樣品製作到智慧零售的應用；「AI豬隻瘦肉量自動化檢測系統」則透過影像辨識，串聯飼養、肉質分級與零售端數據，讓科技深入傳統農畜養殖產業，協助提升生產效率與品質管理。
對企業而言，今年未來科技館遴選出84件獲獎技術，橫跨AI、半導體與光電通訊、生技新藥與醫材、先進材料與化工、綠能環保、淨零及人文科技等領域，其中多項成果已完成初步驗證，或正與產業展開合作。
面對AI高效能運算帶來的散熱與能耗挑戰，「跨重力場被動式螺旋結構液氣分流散熱技術」運用獨創氣泡脫離機制，可整合於高功率AI晶片及資料中心兩相浸沒式冷卻系統；國研院展出的「晶片級先進封裝異質整合平台」，則提供先進製程級別的封裝技術，並獨創去除封裝基板的「CoCoB 」架構，滿足現代資料中心龐大的算力需求。

AI醫療部分，展出診斷平台鎖定早期不易發現的胰臟癌，並已完成跨國臨床盲測驗證；「DeepBT A+腦瘤MRI智慧輔助判讀系統」累積逾2,500例臨床案例，可協助醫療人員進行多任務病灶分析與報告生成，縮短報告周轉時間58%。「PanMETAI—1H NMR代謝體與AI聯合診斷平台」鎖定早期不易發現的胰臟癌，並已完成跨國臨床盲測驗證；「DeepBT A+腦瘤MRI智慧輔助判讀系統」累積逾2,500例臨床案例，可協助醫療人員進行多任務病灶分析與報告生成，縮短報告周轉時間58%。這些成果顯示，AI不只追求模型效能，更能進一步回應臨床流程、產業導入及實際應用需求。
除了產業應用，未來科技館也呈現國家級科研設施與學研團隊如何支援關鍵科技發展，回應環境監測、防災應變、公共安全與國家韌性等需求；國家太空中心以福爾摩沙衛星八號為展出主軸，展示衛星模型、推進次系統、光學遙測酬載及次米級影像應用平臺等成果，讓民眾與產業界了解台灣衛星自主研發的最新進展及太空科技在環境監測、農業、交通與國土管理等領域的應用潛力。
paras_en: The 2026 Taiwan Innovation Technology Expo – Future Technology Hall (FUTEX) will be held from September 17‑19 this week at Hall 1 of the Taipei World Trade Center, organized by the National Science and Technology Council together with Academia Sinica, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Health and Welfare, and the Ministry of Sports. The council says this year’s Future Technology Hall focuses on three pillars – AI life applications, key industrial technologies, and national research – and will exhibit achievements ranging from smart health, sports events and virtual fitting rooms to AI chip cooling, early‑cancer screening, autonomous satellites and intelligent disaster prevention, fully demonstrating AI highlights with the most experiential, industrial potential and social value.

The council states that this year’s Future Technology Hall concentrates on three major aspects, showcasing results from smart health, sports events and virtual fitting rooms to AI chip cooling, early‑cancer screening, autonomous satellites and intelligent disaster prevention, presenting technology highlights that are highly experiential, industrially promising, and socially valuable.

The council points out that AI is no longer confined to models and data in research labs; it has entered people’s health, entertainment, consumption and dietary lives. This year’s exhibition plans multiple interactive experiences so the public can directly feel how AI responds to real‑world needs.

One exhibit is the “iMirror AI Health Promotion and Empowerment Interactive Mirror” developed by Kaohsiung University of Science and Technology. Using a single camera and edge AI computing, it can analyze gait stability, fitness level and fall risk. Visitors who stand, walk or stretch in front of the mirror see real‑time analysis results, a technology that could later be applied to hospital rehabilitation tracking and home care.

Baseball fans can check out an AI sports‑broadcast system that “understands players’ nicknames.” Developed by a team from National Taiwan University of Science and Technology, it combines speech recognition and multimodal AI to automatically tag home runs, strike‑outs and other events. Users simply say a player’s name or nickname, and the system quickly retrieves and plays the relevant clip, showcasing new possibilities for AI in sports broadcasting, video‑content management and entertainment.

A “generative‑AI virtual fitting system” lets visitors stand before a screen and experience AI‑driven applications from garment design and sample production to smart retail. An “AI automated pork leanness detection system” uses image recognition to link breeding, meat‑grade classification and retail data, bringing technology deep into traditional livestock farming to help improve production efficiency and quality control.

For businesses, this year’s Future Technology Hall selected 84 award‑winning technologies spanning AI, semiconductors and optoelectronic communications, biotech drugs and medical devices, advanced materials and chemicals, green energy, net‑zero initiatives, and humanities‑tech. Many of these results have completed preliminary validation or are already collaborating with industry.

Facing the heat‑dissipation and power‑consumption challenges of high‑performance AI computing, a “cross‑gravity‑field passive spiral‑structure liquid‑gas split cooling technology” uses a novel bubble‑release mechanism and can be integrated into high‑power AI chips and two‑phase immersion cooling systems for data centers; Academia Sinica’s “chip‑level advanced packaging heterogeneous integration platform” offers advanced‑process‑level packaging and a unique “CoCoB” architecture that removes the substrate, meeting the massive compute demand of modern data centers.

In AI medical applications, a diagnostic platform targeting early‑stage pancreatic cancer has completed multinational blind clinical trials; the “DeepBT A+ brain‑tumor MRI intelligent assistance system” has accumulated over 2,500 clinical cases, helping clinicians perform multi‑task lesion analysis and report generation, cutting report turnaround time by 58%; the “PanMETAI – 1H NMR metabolomics and AI joint diagnostic platform” also focuses on early pancreatic cancer and has finished cross‑border blind trials. These achievements show that AI not only pursues model performance but also addresses clinical workflow, industry adoption, and real‑world needs.

Beyond industry uses, the Future Technology Hall also showcases national research facilities and academic teams supporting key technology development, responding to environmental monitoring, disaster response, public safety and national resilience needs. The National Space Organization highlights the Formosa Satellite‑8, displaying satellite models, propulsion subsystems, optical remote‑sensing payloads and sub‑meter imaging platforms, helping the public and industry understand Taiwan’s latest autonomous satellite progress and the potential of space technology for environmental monitoring, agriculture, transportation and land‑management.

items.title: 財部拍板中韓電磁鋼品傾銷 追繳反傾銷稅最高達59%
items.title_en: Ministry of Finance Approves Anti-Dumping Duties on Korean and Chinese Electromagnetic Steel, Up to 59%
paras: 財政部今（15）日公告針對自韓國及中國大陸進口「冷軋扁軋非方向性電磁鋼品」反傾銷調查最終認定，確認兩地涉案廠商均存在傾銷事實。其中韓國廠商傾銷差率最高達59.35%，中國廠商則為26.44%。關務署已通知各海關自即日起改依最後認定傾銷差率臨時課徵反傾銷稅，並已移送經濟部進行國家經濟利益與產業損害之最後認定，最快於50天內提報關稅稅率審議小組決定是否正式開徵。
本次反傾銷調查案係由國內鋼鐵龍頭中鋼 (2002-TW) 提出申請。關務署表示，財政部於115年9月15日正式公告調查結果，證實自韓國及中國進口之冷軋扁軋非方向性電磁鋼品確實對國內產業造成不公競爭。
根據財政部最後認定之傾銷差率如下：
關務署說明，財政部先前於115年6月2日公告初步認定結果，並自6月8日起實施臨時課徵反傾銷稅。由於本次最後認定之傾銷差率有所調整，關務署已同步通知各進口地海關，自9月15日起改依最後認定之最新傾銷差率進行臨時課徵。若最終審議核定無須課徵反傾銷稅，先前臨時課徵之款項將依法辦理退還。
針對後續調查流程，關務署進一步指出，財政部已依據「平衡稅及反傾銷稅課徵實施辦法」規定，通知經濟部繼續完成傾銷是否對台灣產業造成損害之最後調查認定，並評估課稅對國家整體經濟利益之影響。經濟部將於接獲通知翌日起40日內完成調查認定；財政部則會在收到經濟部通知後10日內，提交關稅稅率審議小組審議，以做出最終是否正式課徵反傾銷稅之決議。
paras_en: The Ministry of Finance announced today (the 15th) the final anti‑dumping investigation results for imports of "cold‑rolled flat‑rolled non‑grain-oriented electromagnetic steel" from South Korea and mainland China, confirming that manufacturers in both regions have engaged in dumping. The Korean firms’ dumping margin tops out at 59.35%, while the Chinese firms’ margin is 26.44%. The Customs Administration has instructed all customs offices to start levying provisional anti‑dumping duties based on the final margin rates from today, and the case has been forwarded to the Ministry of Economic Affairs for a final determination of national economic interest and industry damage, with a proposal to the Tariff Rate Review Committee expected within 50 days.

The anti‑dumping case was initiated by domestic steel leader China Steel (2002‑TW). The Customs Administration said the Ministry of Finance formally announced the investigation results on September 15, 2026, confirming that imports of cold‑rolled flat‑rolled non‑grain‑oriented electromagnetic steel from Korea and China create unfair competition for the local industry.
The Ministry of Finance’s final determined dumping margins are as follows:

The Customs Administration explained that the Ministry of Finance previously announced a preliminary determination on June 2, 2026, and began provisional anti‑dumping duties on June 8. Because the final dumping margins have been adjusted, customs offices have been notified to apply the updated provisional duties starting September 15. If the final review decides no duties are required, the previously collected provisional duties will be refunded according to law.

Regarding the next steps, the Customs Administration said the Ministry of Finance, pursuant to the "Implementation Measures for Balanced Tax and Anti‑Dumping Tax," has instructed the Ministry of Economic Affairs to complete the final assessment of whether dumping harms Taiwan’s industry and to evaluate the impact of the duties on overall national economic interests. The Ministry of Economic Affairs will finish its investigation within 40 days of receiving the notice, and the Ministry of Finance will submit the findings to the Tariff Rate Review Committee within 10 days thereafter to decide whether to impose formal anti‑dumping duties.

items.title: 能率亞洲現增案完成募集4.61億元 現增股9/18上櫃買賣
items.title_en: Nengli Asia Completes Capital Raise of NT$461 million; New Shares to Trade on OTC on Sep 18
paras: 創投業指標股能率亞洲 (7777-TW)執行上櫃以來首度的市場籌資案，能率亞洲發行1.6萬張現增股，以每股28.8元發行，今(15)日宣布完成募 籌資約4.61億元，現增股9月18日上櫃交易。
能率亞洲的此一發行1.6萬張現增股的市場籌資案，由第一金證券主辦，由全體股東依持股比例認購。募集資金用途將爲充實營運資金。
能率亞洲今天股價收在35.35元，相較於現增價有仍有22.74%的價差空間，且能率亞洲並已取得 OTC 的融資、融券交易資格。
目前能率亞洲著眼投資四大領域，包含 AI 供應鏈、機器人、半導體、軍工，著眼在產業發展趨勢。同時亦布局高殖利率股，兼顧獲利穩定。
同時，全球首家成功商業化機器人廠商 Agility，是能率亞洲在機器人概念的重點持股。能率亞洲及能率集團相關資金合計投資約 1000 萬美元，Agility Robotics 已與主要客戶完成完整測試，結果符合預期，並與豐田汽車就加拿大工廠物流自動化啟動概念驗證。
能率亞洲2026年上半年財報稅後純益1.51億元，每股純益0.81元。
paras_en: Venture-capital benchmark stock Nengli Asia (7777‑TW) executed its first market capital‑raising since listing on the OTC, issuing 16,000 new shares at NT$28.8 each. The company announced today (the 15th) that it has completed fundraising of about NT$461 million, and the new shares will begin OTC trading on September 18.
The 16,000‑share issuance was organized by First Financial Securities, with all shareholders subscribing in proportion to their holdings. The proceeds will be used to strengthen working capital.
Nengli Asia’s stock closed today at NT$35.35, leaving a 22.74% price gap above the issuance price, and the company has already obtained OTC financing and margin‑trading qualifications.

The company is focusing its investments on four major areas—AI supply chain, robotics, semiconductors and defense industry—aligned with industry trends, while also allocating to high‑yield stocks for stable earnings.

Agility Robotics, the world’s first company to successfully commercialize robots, is a key robotics‑concept holding for Nengli Asia. Together with the Nengli Group, they have invested roughly US$10 million; Agility Robotics has completed full testing with major customers, meeting expectations, and has launched a proof‑of‑concept with Toyota for logistics automation at a Canadian plant.
Nengli Asia reported a post‑tax net profit of NT$151 million for the first half of 2026, equating to earnings of NT$0.81 per share.

items.title: 建構全台環島車充電路網 交通部：截至目前公共充電樁已逾1.6萬槍
items.title_en: Building a Nationwide Island‑wide EV Charging Network: MOEA Reports Over 16,000 Public Chargers
paras: 為建構電動車友善使用環境，滿足日益成長的電動車充電需求，交通部推動公共充電樁建置，截至今(2026)年7月底，全國公共充電樁總數已達16,280槍，對應同期電動小客車登記數共149,322輛，車樁比為9.2:1，優於歐盟建議之10:1，其中快充的車樁比為35.7:1，也優於歐盟建議之80:1。
交通部路政司指出，為布局環臺充電路網，解決電動車駕駛在公路沿線上之長途里程焦慮，相關部屬機關已於各所屬轄管場域設有充電站點，提供民眾中繼補電之服務。
交通部舉例，在國道上，高公局已於2024年8月完成「國道服務區充電路網全面上線」，且全數為200kW以上快充樁，七成為350、360kW，配合電動車數量成長，高公路在今年度更針對清水服務區及湖口服務區(南北站)，已啟動優先擴充充電車位作業，三站各增設4格，共計擴充12格，持續提升電動車充電服務；清水服務區已於今年2月擴充完成並開始營運，目前國道快充站共計設有154格充電車位。
另外，在西部主要幹線台61線西濱快速公路沿線，公路局已分別於新豐休息站、大安休息站及口湖休息站共計設有13槍快充樁；東部地區則有台鐵公司亦於去(2025)年7月完成啟用「宜花東充電站網絡」，沿著台9線公路及緊臨台鐵車站， 於宜蘭縣、花蓮縣及臺東縣9個站點，共計設置20槍公共充電樁，緩解民眾在東部駕駛電動車之里程焦慮。
路政司官員表示，隨著公部門帶頭布建，國內的電動車充電環境已逐步完善，並帶動民間充電樁市場發展日趨蓬勃，據資料蒐集顯示，目前已有54家充電營運商投入充電服務，相較2023年第3季總家數成長更達一倍以上。
未來交通部除持續攜手相關部會與地方政府推動增設公共充電樁外，政策推動亦將由初期「積極擴增數量」階段，深化至「提升營運服務品質」階段，如確保充電設施可用性、也督促業者落實營運管理等，藉此打造更便捷、可靠且友善的公共充電服務網絡。
paras_en: To create an EV‑friendly environment and meet the growing demand for electric‑vehicle charging, the Ministry of Transportation and Communications (MOTC) has been promoting the installation of public charging stations. As of the end of July 2026, the total number of public chargers nationwide reached 16,280 units, corresponding to 149,322 registered electric passenger cars, yielding a vehicle‑to‑charger ratio of 9.2:1—better than the EU’s recommended 10:1. For fast chargers, the ratio is 35.7:1, also surpassing the EU’s 80:1 guideline.

The MOTC’s Road Administration Department noted that, to establish an island‑wide charging network and alleviate long‑distance range anxiety for EV drivers on highways, relevant agencies have set up charging stations within their respective jurisdictions to provide intermediate recharging services for the public.

The ministry cited that on national highways, the Highways Bureau completed the “Comprehensive Launch of Highway Service Area Charging Network” in August 2024, installing only fast chargers of 200 kW or higher, with 70 % rated at 350‑360 kW. In response to rising EV numbers, the bureau has prioritized expanding charging spots at Qingshui and Hukou service areas (north‑south stations) this year, adding four spots at each of the three stations for a total of 12 new spots. Qingshui’s expansion was completed and began operation in February 2024, bringing the total number of fast‑charging spots on national highways to 154.

Along the western main corridor, the Taiwan Provincial Highway 61 West Coast Expressway, the Highway Bureau has installed 13 fast‑charging units at Xin‑Feng, Da‑An, and Kou‑Lu rest areas. In the east, Taiwan Railways Administration launched the “Yihua‑Dong Charging Station Network” in July 2025, placing 20 public chargers across nine stations in Yilan, Hualien and Taitung along Highway 9 and adjacent railway stations, easing range anxiety for eastern EV drivers.

A Road Administration official said that as the public sector leads the rollout, the domestic EV charging environment is gradually improving, spurring robust growth in the private‑sector charging market. Data shows that 54 charging operators are now providing services, more than double the number recorded in Q3 2023.

Going forward, the MOTC will continue collaborating with other ministries and local governments to add more public chargers. Policy focus will shift from the initial “aggressive quantity expansion” phase to a “enhancing service quality” phase, ensuring charger availability and urging operators to implement proper management, thereby building a more convenient, reliable, and user‑friendly public charging network.

items.title: 永虹先進單日股價重挫逾6成遭停牌 原因有這些
items.title_en: Yonghong Advanced Shares Plunge Over 60% in One Day and Halted Trading, Reasons Explained
paras:
永虹先進(6618-TW)今(15)日股價重挫多達64.8%，因達主管機關櫃買中心興櫃股票買賣辦法第11-1條，遭暫停交易，永虹也發布重訊表示，公司董事辭任，主協辦輔導推薦券商也辭任。

永虹說明，昨日接獲主辦輔導推薦券商統一綜合證券和協辦輔導推薦券商康和綜合證券通知，因基於業務規劃考量辭任，辭任生效後，將無輔導推薦券商，依興櫃股票審查準則 第40條第1項第3款規定，櫃買中心得終止公司興櫃股票櫃檯買賣，實際終止交易日依櫃買中心公告為準。
永虹也指出，在終止交易日尚未生效前，已積極接洽其他券商擔任主辦輔導推薦券商，造成股東不便，表達萬分歉意。
同時，永虹公告，自然人董事莊士杰因個人業務規劃辭任。
永虹8月合併營收80萬元，年增7.53%，累計前8月合併營收2307萬元，年增25.67%，公司目標深耕航太級高階熱塑性碳纖維複合材料。
永虹日前表態，南投新廠已取得AS9100D航太品質系統認證，且歐系軍工廠代表有到廠交流，正持續拓展國際航太供應鏈及高階應用市場，而近年積極將材料技術延伸至AI伺服器等領域。
不過，此次永虹董事辭任、輔導券商也辭任，造成股價單日重挫超過60%，未來動態仍有待觀察。
paras_en: Yonghong Advanced (6618-TW) saw its share price tumble as much as 64.8% today (the 15th), triggering a trading suspension under Article 11‑1 of the OTC Market’s rules for emerging stocks. The company also issued a major announcement stating that its directors have resigned and that both the lead and co‑lead brokerage firms that were providing guidance have stepped down.

Yonghong explained that it received notices yesterday from its lead brokerage, Uni‑Com Securities, and its co‑lead brokerage, Kanghe Securities, that they would resign for business‑planning reasons. Once their resignations take effect, the company will have no guiding broker, and under Item 3 of Paragraph 1 of Article 40 of the OTC stock review criteria, the OTC Market may terminate trading of the company’s emerging‑stock shares. The exact termination date will be determined by the OTC Market’s announcement.

Yonghong also noted that, before the termination date becomes effective, it is actively seeking other brokerages to serve as the lead and co‑lead guiding firms and apologizes to shareholders for any inconvenience caused.
The company further disclosed that individual director Mr. Zhuang Shijie resigned due to personal business planning.

Yonghong reported August consolidated revenue of NT$800,000, a year‑over‑year increase of 7.53%, and cumulative revenue for the first eight months of NT$23.07 million, up 25.67% year‑over‑year. The company aims to deepen its focus on aerospace‑grade high‑performance thermoplastic carbon‑fiber composites.

The firm recently announced that its new plant in Nantou has obtained AS9100D aerospace quality system certification, and representatives from European‑type defense manufacturers have visited the facility. Yonghong is continuing to expand its international aerospace supply chain and high‑end application markets, and in recent years has been actively extending its material technology into AI server and other fields.

items.title: 桂盟擬辦理私募現金增資發行4500張 將引進策略投資人
items.title_en: Guimei Plans Private Placement Cash Capital Increase of 45 Million Shares, Will Bring in Strategic Investors
paras: 自行車產業景氣回復中，全球最大的金屬鏈條廠桂盟(5306-TW)董事會今日通過決議，擬以私募方式辦理現金增資普通股4500萬，引進策略投資人，並將於11月5日舉行股東臨時會來核准本次私募增資案。
桂盟表示，本次預計所選擇之策略投資人，是以產業中的領導廠商為主，加強與策略投資人合作，藉其本身在產品、技術、品牌知名度或全球通路等，經由產業垂直整合、水平整合或共同研究開發商品或市場等方式，與本公司共同擴大產品線、提高技術、改良品質、降低成本、增進效率、擴大市場等效益。
桂盟隨著自行車產業復甦，桂盟今(2026)年上半年營收與營業利益雙雙成長10%。累計1-8月營收成長11%。
paras_en: The bicycle industry is recovering, and the board of Guimei (5306‑TW), the world’s largest metal chain manufacturer, approved today a resolution to raise cash through a private placement of 45 million ordinary shares, inviting strategic investors. The private‑placement capital increase will be put to a shareholder‑special meeting on November 5 for approval.

Guimei says the targeted strategic investors will be leading firms in the industry. By strengthening cooperation, the company aims to leverage the investors’ product portfolios, technology, brand recognition, or global distribution networks to achieve vertical and horizontal integration, joint R&D, and co‑development of products or markets, thereby expanding product lines, enhancing technology, improving quality, reducing costs, boosting efficiency, and enlarging market reach.
With the bicycle sector’s revival, Guimei’s revenue and operating profit both grew 10% in the first half of 2026, and cumulative revenue for January‑August rose 11%.

items.title: 佳邦庫藏股提前半個月達陣 斥1.53億元買回2000張均價76.56元
items.title_en: JiaBang completes treasury‑stock buyback half a month early, spending NT$153 million to repurchase 2,000 lots at an average of NT$76.56 per share
paras: 天線及磁性元件廠佳邦(6284-TW)今(15)日公告，買回庫藏股執行完畢，共斥資1.53億元，買回2000張，平均每股買回價格76.56元，較原定計畫提前半個月達陣。
佳邦表示，本次原訂買回庫藏股期間為8月3日至9月30日，買回區間價格65-77元，實際買回期間為8月4日至9月15日，買回股份將轉讓予員工，累計佳邦目前已持有自家股票3000張，占公司已發行股份總數2.01%。
佳邦受惠下半年產業庫存逐步回歸健康水位，加上新產品、新客戶與新應用陸續發酵，公司預期營運可望逐步回溫，其中天線事業將持續深化高精度定位與無線連結技術，布局低軌衛星及非地面網路（NTN），並投入高頻天線、衛星通訊天線及射頻技術研發。
被動元件方面，佳邦聚焦功率電感、電磁干擾抑制及保護元件，其中一體成型功率電感可應用於AI伺服器、高速運算平台、固態硬碟及高速網通設備。公司指出，AI伺服器與高速運算平台升級，不僅帶動被動元件用量增加，也推升高電流、高耐溫及高可靠度產品需求。
佳邦表示，未來將整合天線與被動元件優勢，提供涵蓋定位、通訊及訊號管理的一站式解決方案，持續深化高頻通訊與智慧連接技術布局，掌握AI基礎建設、高速網通及新世代通訊等市場商機。
paras_en: JiaBang (6284‑TW), a manufacturer of antennas and magnetic components, announced today (the 15th) that its treasury‑stock repurchase has been completed, spending NT$153 million to buy back 2,000 lots at an average price of NT$76.56 per share, achieving the goal half a month ahead of schedule.

The company said the original buyback window was set for August 3 to September 30 with a price range of NT$65‑77. The actual repurchase took place from August 4 to September 15, and the shares will be transferred to employees. To date, JiaBang holds 3,000 of its own shares, representing 2.01% of the total issued shares.

JiaBang benefits from a gradual return of industry inventory to healthy levels in the second half of the year, and from new products, customers and applications coming online. The firm expects operations to warm up gradually, with its antenna business continuing to deepen high‑precision positioning and wireless‑link technologies, positioning itself for low‑Earth‑orbit satellites and non‑terrestrial networks (NTN), and investing in high‑frequency antennas, satellite‑communication antennas and RF R&D.

In the passive‑component segment, JiaBang focuses on power inductors, EMI suppression and protection devices. Its monolithic power inductors can be used in AI servers, high‑speed computing platforms, solid‑state drives and high‑speed networking equipment. The company noted that upgrades of AI servers and high‑speed computing platforms not only increase demand for passive components but also drive need for high‑current, high‑temperature‑resistant and highly reliable products.

JiaBang said it will integrate its antenna and passive‑component strengths to offer one‑stop solutions covering positioning, communications and signal management, continue to deepen its high‑frequency communications and smart‑connectivity technology roadmap, and capture market opportunities in AI infrastructure, high‑speed networking and next‑generation communications.

items.title: 華爾街劃出美股生死線！10年期美債殖利率攻入危險區
items.title_en: Wall Street Draws a Survival Line for US Stocks! 10-Year Treasury Yield Enters Dangerous Zone
paras: 美國10年期公債殖利率近3年來首度突破5%，正值美股進入歷來波動較劇烈的時期，進一步升高市場修正壓力。策略師認為，殖利率突破5%本身未必足以終結多頭，真正關鍵在於接下來上升的速度，以及聯準會(Fed)周三升息後，是否暗示還有更多緊縮行動。

殖利率升破5% 科技股估值首當其衝

與2023年10月美債殖利率突破5%時不同，當時標普500指數較歷史高點低約10%，目前卻僅較8月創下的紀錄低約2.5%，市場也開始懷疑，美股是否尚未充分反映債市風險。
富國銀行(WFC-US)等機構策略師指出，殖利率對美股的實際衝擊，將取決於後續上升速度。若殖利率短時間內急漲，勢必加劇華爾街焦慮；如果只是緩步攀升，市場可能仍有時間消化。
公債殖利率走高會降低企業未來獲利的現值，並使股票相較低風險債券失去吸引力，同時推升企業融資成本、侵蝕利潤率。其中，高成長、高本益比科技股尤其脆弱，因為這類公司的估值高度仰賴多年後才能實現的獲利。

多名策略師已為美股劃出警戒線。Wealth Enhancement投資組合經理Max Wasserman認為，美國10年期公債殖利率介於5%至5.25%，將是標普500的心理臨界區；Jackson Square Capital合夥人Andrew Graham則警告，一旦升破5.1%，可能觸發美股修正。22V Research策略師Dennis Debusschere表示，即使殖利率維持在4.8%至5%，也會對經濟成長形成一定壓力。
美股目前仍展現韌性。標普500自3月底低點反彈20%，期間市值增加11兆美元；即使周一債市遭到拋售，華爾街恐慌指數(VIX)仍維持在17附近，尚未顯示市場陷入明顯壓力。不過，Wolfe Research首席經濟學家Stephanie Roth警告，若利率或油價進一步攀升，美股出現更大幅度修正的機率也會提高。

Fed若未釋出「升一次就停」訊號 美股恐承受更大壓力

利率期貨顯示，交易員預估Fed周三升息1碼的機率接近90%。市場焦點將轉向Fed主席華許會後記者會，尋找今年底前是否還會繼續升息的線索。
富國銀行首席股票策略師Ohsung Kwon表示，投資人最樂見Fed傳達「升一次就停」的訊息；若Fed意外按兵不動，反而可能被市場視為利空，因為此舉可能讓投資人懷疑Fed抗通膨的決心，進而推升長天期美債殖利率。
Wasserman也表示，如果Fed暗示升息一次後就踩煞車，交易員可望鬆一口氣；但若華許未說明未來升息次數，或暗示壓低通膨需要更長時間，殖利率維持在5%以上，將迫使投資人重新評估昂貴估值，長天期科技股恐率先下跌。
目前標普500獲利收益率與10年期美債殖利率之間的股權風險溢酬，已接近2002年以來最低，代表投資人持有股票所獲得的額外補償有限。摩根大通(JPM-US)策略師Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou團隊預估，該溢酬可能比歷史平均低100個基點，使美股對殖利率波動更加敏感。
不過，Raymond James(RJF-US)投資長Larry Adam認為，債券投資人情緒已極度悲觀，10年期美債投機性空頭部位也接近歷史高點，這波賣壓可能已經過度延伸，意味殖利率或許更接近高峰，而非新一輪持續上漲的起點。
paras_en: US 10-year Treasury yields have broken above 5% for the first time in three years, coinciding with a historically volatile period for US equities and increasing market correction pressure. Strategists say that the yield crossing 5% alone may not end the bull market; the key is the speed of further rises and whether Wednesday’s Fed rate hike signals more tightening.

The impact on tech stock valuations is immediate. Unlike October 2023, when the 5% yield breach occurred while the S&P 500 was about 10% below its all‑time high, the index is now only about 2.5% below its August record, leading the market to wonder if equities have fully priced in bond‑market risk.

Wells Fargo (WFC‑US) and other institutional strategists note that the actual effect of yields on US stocks will depend on the pace of further increases. A rapid spike would heighten Wall Street anxiety, whereas a gradual climb could give the market time to digest.

Higher Treasury yields lower the present value of future corporate earnings and make stocks less attractive relative to low‑risk bonds, while also raising corporate financing costs and squeezing profit margins. High‑growth, high‑P/E tech stocks are especially vulnerable because their valuations rely heavily on profits many years out.

Several strategists have drawn warning lines for equities. Wealth Enhancement portfolio manager Max Wasserman sees a 5%‑5.25% 10‑year yield as a psychological threshold for the S&P 500; Jackson Square Capital partner Andrew Graham warns that a breach of 5.1% could trigger a correction; 22V Research’s Dennis Debusschere says even a 4.8%‑5% range would put pressure on economic growth.

US equities still show resilience. The S&P 500 has rebounded about 20% from its late‑March low, adding $11 trillion in market cap; even after Monday’s bond‑sell‑off, the VIX stayed near 17, showing no clear sign of stress. However, Wolfe Research chief economist Stephanie Roth cautions that further rate or oil price hikes could raise the odds of a larger equity correction.

If the Fed does not signal a “one‑and‑done” hike, US stocks could face greater pressure. Rate‑futures indicate a near‑90% chance the Fed will raise rates by 0.25% on Wednesday, shifting focus to Chair Jerome Powell’s post‑meeting press conference for clues on whether more hikes are coming before year‑end.

Wells Fargo chief equity strategist Ohsung Kwon says investors would welcome a “one‑and‑done” message from the Fed; an unexpected pause could be viewed as negative, suggesting doubts about the Fed’s resolve on inflation and potentially pushing long‑term yields higher.

Wasserman adds that if the Fed signals a pause after one hike, traders could breathe easier; but if Powell leaves future hikes ambiguous or hints that taming inflation will take longer, yields staying above 5% would force investors to reassess pricey valuations, with long‑term tech stocks likely to fall first.

The equity risk premium—the spread between the S&P 500 earnings yield and the 10‑year Treasury yield—is now near its lowest since 2002, indicating limited extra compensation for holding stocks. JPMorgan (JPM‑US) strategist Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou’s team estimates the premium could be about 100 basis points below its historical average, making equities more sensitive to yield moves.

Nevertheless, Raymond James (RJF‑US) chief investment officer Larry Adam argues bond‑market sentiment is extremely bearish, with speculative short positions on the 10‑year Treasury near historic highs. This selling pressure may be overextended, suggesting yields could be near their peak rather than the start of a new sustained rise.

items.title: 升級後故障照樣收錢？蘋果「軟體不保固」條款遭印度調查
items.title_en: Upgraded Yet Still Charged? Apple’s “Software Not Covered by Warranty” Clause Under Investigation in India
paras: 印度消費者監管機關正升級調查蘋果(AAPL-US)的軟體保固條款，起因是部分消費者指控，升級iOS 18後出現螢幕及麥克風故障，卻因蘋果不為軟體提供保固，被迫支付「高得離譜」的維修費用。若違法事實成立，蘋果除可能遭到罰款，也可能被要求退款或修改現行保固與營運做法。

印度下令深入調查 蘋果否認iOS 18存在系統性問題

《路透》取得的文件顯示，印度中央消費者保護局(CCPA)去年收到大量申訴，指蘋果2024年底推出iOS 18後，部分iPhone出現螢幕顯示異常、麥克風故障等問題，但因軟體不在保固範圍內，消費者必須自行負擔維修費。
CCPA今年7月29日通知蘋果，已將案件交由調查部門進行「深入調查」，並指案件涉及涉嫌侵害消費者權益。此舉顯示印度政府並不滿意蘋果先前提出的說明，也提高公司遭到處分的風險。
蘋果在8月提交的回函中反駁指控，強調iOS 18經過嚴格測試，在印度並未發現系統性問題或安全疑慮，且調查僅源自75件申訴。截至2026年6月，仍使用iOS 18的iPhone占比也只有約11%。蘋果表示，將繼續與印度主管機關合作，釐清消費者反映的問題。
印度消費者法允許調查人員要求企業提交文件並舉行聽證，之後再向監管機關提出最終報告。專精消費者法的律師Kirti Mahapatra表示，若契約或保固條款被認定構成不公平交易行為，CCPA可要求企業向消費者提供正確資訊，甚至修改相關條款，但後者在印度將是前所未見的作法。

軟體故障不在保固範圍 維修費超過手機售價三分之一

蘋果的軟體授權協議載明，軟體「不附帶任何形式的保固」，若軟體發生瑕疵，相關維修成本須由使用者自行承擔，全球有限保固僅涵蓋硬體。
蘋果主張，軟體不提供保固符合全球產業慣例，消費者也會在安裝前得知相關條款，其內容與索尼(SONY-US)、三星電子等電子產品大廠相近。公司並稱，如果每項軟體問題都被視為違反絕對保固，等同要求所有軟體供應商為一切科技風險承擔保險責任。
不過，CCPA指控，部分iPhone在升級iOS 18後，螢幕出現綠色、粉紅色或白色線條，消費者即使認為故障源自軟體更新，仍須支付高額費用更換螢幕。以iPhone 15為例，螢幕維修估計需27,900盧比(約291美元)，超過手機零售價的三分之一。
CCPA認為，若問題源自蘋果本身的疏失，卻仍向消費者收取維修費，恐違反公平交易原則。義大利早在2018年也曾處分蘋果，原因是公司未充分告知消費者，iOS 10可能影響舊款iPhone效能，且未向保固期外的裝置提供適當支援。
這項調查也為蘋果在印度的擴張增添變數。印度是蘋果重要成長市場，公司正快速擴大當地iPhone製造規模，市占率也從2022年的4%升至2025年的9%，但同時還須應對涉嫌違反印度反壟斷法的指控。
paras_en: India's consumer regulator is escalating its probe into Apple (AAPL-US) software warranty terms after some consumers claimed that after upgrading to iOS 18 they experienced screen and microphone failures, but because Apple does not provide a warranty for software they were forced to pay "exorbitant" repair costs. If the alleged violations are confirmed, Apple could face fines, be ordered to refund customers, or have to change its warranty and operational practices.

India ordered a deep dive into the matter, with Apple denying any systemic issues in iOS 18. Reuters obtained documents showing that the Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) received a flood of complaints last year alleging that after Apple rolled out iOS 18 at the end of 2024, some iPhones showed screen anomalies and microphone failures, yet because the software is not covered by warranty, consumers had to bear repair expenses themselves.

The CCPA notified Apple on July 29 that it had referred the case to its investigation unit for a "thorough inquiry," indicating the matter involves alleged infringement of consumer rights. This move shows the Indian government is unsatisfied with Apple's earlier explanations and raises the risk of punitive action against the company.

In a response filed in August, Apple rebutted the accusations, stressing that iOS 18 underwent rigorous testing, that no systemic or safety issues have been found in India, and that the investigation stems from only 75 complaints. As of June 2026, only about 11% of iPhones still run iOS 18. Apple said it will continue cooperating with Indian authorities to clarify the consumer‑raised issues.

India’s consumer law allows investigators to demand documents from companies and hold hearings before submitting a final report to the regulator. Consumer‑law specialist Kirti Mahapatra said that if a contract or warranty clause is deemed an unfair trade practice, the CCPA can compel the company to provide correct information to consumers and even amend the clause – a step unprecedented in India.

Apple’s software license agreement states that the software "comes with no warranty of any kind," and if a software defect occurs, the user must bear any repair costs; the limited global warranty covers only hardware.

Apple argues that offering no warranty on software aligns with global industry practice and that consumers are informed of the terms before installation, noting that the language is similar to that used by Sony (SONY-US), Samsung Electronics and other major electronics makers. The company adds that treating every software issue as a breach of an absolute warranty would effectively require all software vendors to carry insurance for every technological risk.

However, the CCPA alleges that some iPhones, after upgrading to iOS 18, displayed green, pink or white lines on the screen, and even if consumers attribute the fault to the software update they still have to pay high fees to replace the screen. For an iPhone 15, screen repair is estimated at 27,900 rupees (about $291), more than one‑third of the phone’s retail price.

The CCPA contends that if the problem stems from Apple’s own negligence yet the company still charges consumers for repairs, it may violate fair‑trade principles. Italy similarly penalised Apple in 2018 for failing to adequately inform consumers that iOS 10 could affect performance on older iPhone models and for not providing proper support to devices out of warranty.

The investigation adds uncertainty to Apple’s expansion plans in India. India is a key growth market for Apple, which is rapidly scaling local iPhone manufacturing and has lifted its market share from 4% in 2022 to 9% in 2025, but it also faces allegations of breaching Indian antitrust laws.

items.title: 為何Google、Meta逆勢上漲？AI巨頭喊放慢開發科技股承壓
items.title_en: Why Google and Meta Rise Against the Trend? AI Giants Call for Slowing Development, Tech Stocks Under Pressure
paras: 在 Anthropic、OpenAI 與SpaceX(SPCX-US) 高層相繼呼籲放慢人工智慧（AI）開發之際，科技股週一（14日）普遍承壓，但Google(GOOGL-US) 母公司 Alphabet 與 Facebook 母公司Meta(META-US) 反而受到投資人青睞，股價逆勢走高。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，Alphabet 股價週一收盤上漲3.22%，Meta 也上漲2.71%；與此同時，科技股占比較高的那斯達克100指數則下跌0.82%，市場持續消化 AI 開發速度可能放緩的影響。
分析指出，Alphabet 與 Meta 都正在打造各自的 AI 系統，因此若 Claude、ChatGPT 與 Grok 背後的開發商協調放慢 AI 發展腳步，兩家公司可能成為受惠者。
Google 本月稍早推出最新版本 Gemini 聊天機器人 Gemini 3.8 Flash；Meta 面向消費者的 AI 代理 Muse 則在上週躍居 App Store 排名前三名。
不過，根據 OpenLM 大型語言模型排行榜，Gemini 與 Muse 的最新版本目前排名仍落後於 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5.1、OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Astra，以及 SpaceX 的 Grok-4.6。
因此，若目前領先的三大 AI 公司放慢開發速度，Alphabet 與 Meta 與競爭對手之間的差距可能縮小，AI 市場的競爭格局也可能因此改變。
New Street Research 分析師 Dan Salmon 表示，市場對 AI 風險的疑慮，也可能讓 Alphabet 與 Meta 有更多空間調整自身定位。
其中，Meta 的布局重點放在資料中心租賃，Google 則更加著重自身的分銷與晶片業務。
今年以來，隨著投資人資金大量湧向晶片與記憶體類股，Alphabet 與 Meta 股價表現始終缺乏明確方向。
截至上週五（11日）收盤，Alphabet 年初至今上漲8.2%，Meta 則下跌1.8%。
paras_en: As senior executives at Anthropic, OpenAI and SpaceX (SPCX-US) call for a slowdown in artificial intelligence (AI) development, technology stocks were generally under pressure on Monday (the 14th), but Alphabet, Google’s parent company, and Meta, the parent of Facebook, were instead favored by investors and saw their shares climb against the tide.

According to the Barron’s Weekly report, Alphabet closed up 3.22% on Monday and Meta rose 2.71%; at the same time, the Nasdaq‑100, which has a high weighting of tech stocks, fell 0.82% as the market continued to digest the potential impact of a slower AI development pace.

Analysts note that both Alphabet and Meta are building their own AI systems, so if the developers behind Claude, ChatGPT and Grok coordinate a slowdown in AI progress, the two companies could be beneficiaries.
Google earlier this month launched the latest version of its Gemini chatbot, Gemini 3.8 Flash; Meta’s consumer‑facing AI agent Muse jumped into the top three on the App Store last week.
However, according to the OpenLM large language model ranking, the newest versions of Gemini and Muse still trail Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5.1, OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra and SpaceX’s Grok‑4.6.

Therefore, if the three leading AI firms currently slow their development, the gap between Alphabet and Meta and their rivals could narrow, potentially reshaping the competitive landscape of the AI market.
New Street Research analyst Dan Salmon said that market concerns about AI risks could also give Alphabet and Meta more room to adjust their positioning.
Meta’s strategy focuses on data‑center leasing, while Google places greater emphasis on its distribution and chip businesses.
Since the start of the year, as investors have poured large amounts of capital into chip and memory stocks, Alphabet’s and Meta’s share performance has lacked a clear direction.
As of last Friday’s (the 11th) close, Alphabet is up 8.2% year‑to‑date, while Meta is down 1.8%.

items.title: 全球市場雙重警報！油價飆破107美元、10年期美債殖利率攻上5%
items.title_en: Global Markets Issue Dual Alerts: Oil Prices Surge Past $107 and 10‑Year US Treasury Yields Rise Above 5%
paras: 沙國能源設施接連遭到攻擊，關鍵東西輸油管又持續停擺，加深市場對原油供應中斷的擔憂，布蘭特原油周二升破每桶107美元。油價上漲也加劇通膨疑慮，全球公債賣壓擴大，美國10年期公債殖利率一度突破5%，創近20年新高，並震盪亞洲股市。

沙國出口面臨斷鏈 布蘭特原油上看130美元

《路透》報導，布蘭特原油期貨周二(15日)上漲1.67美元或1.58%，報每桶107.35美元；西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨上漲2.14美元或2.11%，報每桶103.53美元。
葉門獲伊朗支持的青年運動周一再度攻擊沙國，宣稱向南部一處軍事空軍基地發射數十枚飛彈與無人機，鎖定機庫、雷達、跑道及彈藥庫，報復沙國空襲葉門。波斯灣阿拉伯國家隨後延後原定與伊朗舉行的會談，進一步升高衝突長期化的疑慮。
沙國上周五才遭遇另一起攻擊，導致東西輸油管中斷。該管線可將原油輸送至紅海沿岸的延布港，讓出口繞過遭封鎖的荷姆茲海峽，如今停擺恐威脅相當於全球4%的石油供應。買家與交易商警告，若管線無法迅速恢復，沙國可供出口的原油庫存可能在數日內耗盡。
高盛表示，目前對管線修復時間的估計介於「很快」至8周，並可能危及延布港剩餘每日約200萬桶的出口。若2027年波斯灣平均石油產量仍較戰前低每日400萬桶，布蘭特原油突破120美元的機率將上升。凱投宏觀(Capital Economics)則估計，若管線停擺數周，且需求或荷姆茲海峽運輸量未能調整，布蘭特原油可能逼近130美元。
Kpler初步數據顯示，周一通過荷姆茲海峽的商品船隻僅4艘，低於前一天的10艘。俄羅斯供應也承受壓力，六座主要柴油煉油廠中有三座因無人機攻擊受損，9月被迫大幅減產或全面停工。

油價加劇通膨疑慮 美債殖利率突破5%

油價飆升加劇通膨擔憂，加上各國政府債務快速膨脹，全球公債賣壓進一步擴大。美國10年期公債殖利率一度升至5.0328%，創近20年新高。由於該殖利率是美國房貸、企業融資及全球資產定價的重要基準，突破5%後也立即震盪亞洲股市。
市場目前預期聯準會(Fed)周三將升息1碼，並可能在明年年中前再升息約40個基點。投資人也等待美國財政部長貝森特赴國會作證，觀察他能否提出更多穩定債市的措施。貝森特先前雖擴大美債回購，仍未能有效遏止賣壓。
債市動盪也蔓延至其他國家。日本10年期公債殖利率突破3%，創30年新高；澳洲10年期殖利率升至5.41%，三周累計攀升40個基點。德國10年期殖利率逼近2009年來最高，法國同年期殖利率也徘徊在18年高點附近。
英國《每日電訊報》報導，英國央行可能停止出售所持有的20年期及30年期公債，以減輕長債市場壓力。南韓候任財長也表示，正密切關注殖利率上升，必要時將採取措施穩定市場波動。
paras_en: Saudi Arabia’s energy facilities have been repeatedly attacked, and a key east‑west oil pipeline remains shut, deepening market worries about oil‑supply disruptions. Brent crude rose above $107 a barrel on Tuesday. The price jump also fuels inflation concerns, widening pressure on global sovereign bonds as the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield briefly broke the 5% mark, a near‑20‑year high, rattling Asian equity markets.
Reuters reported that Brent futures climbed $1.67, or 1.58%, to $107.35 a barrel on Tuesday, the 15th, while West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures rose $2.14, or 2.11%, to $103.53 a barrel.

A Yemen youth movement backed by Iran attacked Saudi Arabia again on Monday, claiming to have launched dozens of missiles and drones at a southern military air base, targeting hangars, radar, runway and ammunition depots in retaliation for a Saudi airstrike on Yemen. Gulf Arab states then postponed a scheduled meeting with Iran, heightening fears of a protracted conflict.

Saudi Arabia suffered another attack last Friday that knocked out the east‑west oil pipeline. The line can ship crude to the Red Sea port of Yanbu, allowing exports to bypass the blocked Strait of Hormuz, and its shutdown now threatens roughly 4% of global oil supply. Buyers and traders warn that if the pipeline is not quickly restored, Saudi export‑able crude inventories could be exhausted within days.

Goldman Sachs estimates that pipeline repair could take anywhere from “very soon” to eight weeks and could jeopardize the remaining roughly 2 million barrels per day that Yanbu can export. If average Gulf oil production in 2027 remains about 4 million barrels per day lower than pre‑war levels, the odds of Brent breaking $120 increase. Capital Economics projects that a weeks‑long pipeline outage, combined with unchanged demand or limited Hormuz‑shipping capacity, could push Brent toward $130.

Preliminary data from Kpler showed only four commodity vessels transited the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, down from ten the day before. Russian supply is also under strain, with three of six major diesel refineries damaged by drone attacks and forced to sharply cut output or shut down entirely in September.

Rising oil prices are stoking inflation worries, and together with rapidly expanding sovereign debt, global bond‑selling pressure is intensifying. The U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield briefly rose to 5.0328%, a near‑20‑year high. Because this yield is a key benchmark for U.S. mortgages, corporate financing and global asset pricing, the breach of 5% immediately unsettled Asian equity markets.

Markets currently expect the Federal Reserve to raise rates by one basis point on Wednesday and possibly add about 40 basis points more before mid‑next year. Investors are also awaiting Treasury Secretary Yellen’s testimony before Congress to see if she can propose additional measures to stabilise the bond market. Although Yellen has expanded Treasury buybacks, the pressure on Treasuries has not been effectively curbed.

Bond‑market turbulence is spreading to other countries. Japan’s 10‑year government bond yield broke 3%, a 30‑year high; Australia’s 10‑year yield rose to 5.41%, up 40 basis points over three weeks. Germany’s 10‑year yield is approaching its highest level since 2009, and France’s comparable yield is hovering near its 2018 peak.

The UK’s Daily Telegraph reported that the Bank of England may stop selling its holdings of 20‑year and 30‑year bonds to ease pressure on the long‑bond market. South Korea’s incoming finance minister also said he is closely monitoring the rise in yields and will act if necessary to stabilise market volatility.

items.title: 《CLARITY法案》程序表決在即！預測平台估過關機率僅18%　道德、存款、州權三波反對卡死加密立法
items.title_en: Procedural Vote on the CLARITY Act Looms! Forecast Platforms Estimate Only an 18% Chance of Passage – Moral, Deposit, and State‑Rights Opposition Stalls Crypto Legislation
paras: 美國參議院將在美東時間周二(15日)下午2時15分(台灣時間周三(16日)凌晨2時15分)就《數位資產市場清晰法案(CLARITY Act)》(下稱《清晰法案》)舉行程序性表決，必須取得60票才能終止辯論、進入全院審議。這一表決被業界視為美國加密貨幣監管從「執法先行」轉向「成文法框架」年度關鍵，過關不代表即刻成為法律，僅代表進入修正與兩院協調，但不過則代表立法恐拖到新國會再來表決。

《清晰法案》的本質是「市場結構法」。美國眾院去年7月以294比134通過，78名民主黨眾議員贊成，參院今年1月通過商品版本，銀行委員會5月14日以15比9推進。到了7月，懷俄明州共和黨籍參議員Cynthia Lummis發布616頁合併版本，核心為三類分法：比特幣、以太幣等「數位商品」交CFTC；依發行方經營努力定價的「投資合同資產」屬證券、由證交會(SEC)監管，並在8月18日提出《Regulation Crypto Assets》草案，針對被認定為證券的加密貨幣投資合約，首次建立量身打造的「豁免註冊路徑」與資訊揭露架構(類似於 Regulation A 的分級架構)，這標誌著SEC政策由強硬轉向法制化。
目前，法案爭議集中在三大方面；一是道德條款。民主黨要求限制聯邦官員及家屬從加密業務獲利，最新妥協要求「重大」加密利益剝離或納入合規信託、禁止官員發行或贊助代幣；執法權由早期僅聯邦總檢長，擴至州檢可參與，但民主黨麻州參議員華倫仍堅持總檢長須由總統任命、對川普家族相關WLFI、$TRUMP等個案執法存在漏洞。
二是州權爭議。紐約州檢察長Letitia James聯同17名州檢察長反對，擔憂各州證券註冊、反詐與執法權遭削弱，共和黨雖把州檢執法包裝成讓步，仍未換到支持
三是銀行與穩定幣收益。ABA、Bank Policy Institute等8大銀行公會拒絕熔斷機制(circuit breaker)，即社區銀行出現「實質性存款外流」後才由財政部限穩定幣獎勵，要求從源頭禁按餘額、持倉時間變相付息。根據估算，美國銀行體系中高達6.6兆美元的交易性存款，將面臨被穩定幣大舉吸走、甚至逃離傳統金融體系的風險。
目前，市場定價已反映不確定性。預測市場分歧大。部分平台顯示，周一(14日)時的通過機率一度回至30%以上，但隨著州檢、銀行、參議員華倫反對的消息傳出，Polymarket相關機率在周二(15日)亞洲時段回落至約18%，其他平台亦有16%或35%的不同報價。
周二稍早，比特幣在7.7-7.9萬美元區間震盪，部分觀點認為若程序性投票失敗、監管不確定性延續，山寨幣與中市值公鏈折價現象擴大
若進入辯論，比特幣、以太幣因商品身份邊際利多有限，XRP、SOL及未成熟代幣反而受「分類溢價」與成熟認證預期影響更大。
法人機構看的則是合規通道，而非單日K線。通過後，退休金、主權基金可按ETP底層商品、證券型代幣、RWA三類分倉；代幣化國債、黃金走CFTC/SEC雙軌，穩定幣儲備續買短天期美債，對短天期殖利率形成新增需求。
全球層面，歐盟的MiCA、香港穩定幣與虛產交易所制度、新加坡託管規則將與美國SEC/CFTC分界對標，離岸平台除了申請美國牌照回流，就是縮小非美業務範圍。
失敗情景下，SEC與CFTC改以無異議函、聯合解釋、個案執法填空白，SEC主席Paul Atkins任內已有將Reg Crypto式豁免與比特幣、以太幣、Solana、XRP商品歸類，但行政解釋隨人事更替，機構不會把「行政寬鬆」等同「法律確定」。
對台灣與亞洲投資人而言，《清晰法案》不是單一美國內政議題。美元穩定幣若納入聯邦儲備與反洗錢框架，跨境清算、託管、代幣化債券會更快標準化，但銀行存款替代、官員道德與州權三方若談不攏，周二(15日)即便60票通過，後續修正案仍可能重寫穩定幣獎勵、DeFi前端與RWA上幣規則。
總體來看，短期看票數，中期看規則起草，長期則看美國是否真把「加密首都」寫進成文法。
paras_en: The U.S. Senate will hold a procedural vote on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (the “Clarity Act”) on Tuesday at 2:15 p.m. Eastern Time (2:15 a.m. Taiwan time on Wednesday). A super‑majority of 60 votes is required to end debate and move the measure to full‑chamber consideration. The industry sees this vote as the pivotal moment this year when U.S. crypto regulation shifts from an “enforcement‑first” approach to a codified legal framework.
